name: Occupancy Grid Filling
definition: A post-processing step to fill inside regions of an occupancy grid. It identifies the 'outside' label using the corner voxel and fills all other labels with 1, preserving original non-zero values (e.g., colors) if present.
summary: Occupancy Grid Filling fills hollow interiors by treating enclosed voids as solid while preserving original data, differing from visibility culling by focusing on topological closure.
